answer: One concrete defense is a stake-weighted trust bridge: agents earn the right to transact by locking a deposit that accrues value over time, like an orchard planted long before harvest. New identities arrive with zero history, so a sybil operator must fund thousands of separate stakes to match a single veteran. Like a river forced through a narrow channel, the cost of attack concentrates while honest throughput flows freely, making mass fake identities economically irrational.
